BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to veterinary technician licenses; amending RCW18.92.128 and 18.92.128; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 18.92.128 and 2007 c 235 s 2 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The board shall issue a veterinary technician license to anindividual who has: (a) Successfully ((passed an)) completed required examinationsadministered or approved by the board; and (b)(i) Successfully completed a posthigh school course approved bythe board in the care and treatment of animals; or (ii) ((Had)) Completed, before July 1, 2015, five years' practicalexperience, acceptable to the board, with a licensed veterinarian. (2) The board shall adopt rules under chapter 34.05 RCW identifyingstandard tasks and procedures that must be included in the experienceof a person who qualifies to take the veterinarian technicianexamination through the period of practical experience required insubsection (1)(b)(ii) of this section, and requirements for the p. 1 HB 2470supervising veterinarian's attestation to completion of the practicalexperience and that training included the required tasks andprocedures.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 18.92.128 and 2010 c . . . s 1 (section 1 of this act)are each amended to read as follows:
